style.vernacular: Oil-and-port city in the Niger Delta founded in 1913-14 as a British planned railway town: a gridded Old Township with early 20th-century brick and timber colonial administrative buildings under tin roofs, the Old GRA's low-density villas in gardens, and a dense modern sprawl of 2-4 storey painted-render and concrete blocks with long-span coloured metal roofs, heavy rain staining, walled compounds and palms, with oil-industry compounds and waterfront jetties on the creeks.
style.ornament: Colonial verandas and louvred shutters on Old GRA houses; red-brick Government House; rain-stained concrete flyovers and murals themed on the Garden City; palm-lined avenues; Ijaw and Kalabari waterfront jetties with covered passenger sheds.
